title: Judy Samuelson (Aspen Institute B&S Executive Director) on Eric's closing fireside with Ellen McGirt
summary: Judy Samuelson — founder and Executive Director of the Aspen Institute Business & Society Program — publicly names Eric's closing keynote interview with Ellen McGirt of Design Observer as the memorable close of the summit. Frames Incorruptible around the design of the corporation to keep founder intentions secure.
blockquote: A memorable closing interview by Ellen McGirt of Design Observer with Eric Ries on his new book, Incorruptible, and the design of the corporation to keep founder intentions secure against the short-term pressures from both public and private capital markets.
attribution_title: Founder & Executive Director, Aspen Institute Business & Society Program
